notes: DT was already register-to-GM 4B; this changes only FC1 store width and lane shuffles, not GEMM, activation math, barriers or buffer layout.
M16 uses a quad transpose with two 16B writers per row; M64 reuses PF's four-lane transpose.
Production capacity limit remains 64; T256 used the separately archived capacity-only patch.
1/64-token changes are within inter-run variation. T256 improves 0.23%-0.86% across all four rounds; tiny clock excursions remain visible in raw measurements.
Clock polling is every 500 ms and cannot prove constant effective frequency between samples. No individual timing sample was silently dropped.
